rendering_note: This display-only projection starts from observed edit endpoints. It retains complete aromatic bond-connected systems, exocyclic non-aromatic multiple bonds required to complete aromatic valence, contiguous non-aromatic multiple-bond units, directly attached non-carbon atoms, non-aromatic carbon multiple-bond systems directly attached to active heteroatoms, and complete versioned reaction-interface blocks whenever a block intersects or directly bounds the retained interface; otherwise it retains only the active saturated center. Omitted non-aromatic branches become indexed R-group substituent placeholders. Labels are assigned in deterministic reactant-side structural order and then propagated across sides. Mapped placeholders use their center map, attachment map, and mapped fragment atoms as their cross-side identity, so labels remain stable when cyclization changes a fragment's derived environment class; unmapped placeholders fall back to structural identity, and genuinely product-only groups are numbered afterward. An omitted connected subgraph touching multiple displayed ports becomes a labeled hidden connector rendered with nonchemical zero-order dashed bonds. A retained remote subgraph carrying an observed formed-ring path receives such a connector even when its ports belong to the same displayed component, preserving visible cycle topology without expanding the full tether. Unchanged terminal substituents cut from aromatic carbon are hydrogen-capped in the graphic but retained as positional substituent records.
